title: Estudio de vulnerabilidad y riesgo de pueblos indígenas de Chile ante el cambio climático
temporal_coverage: Consultancy report dated 10 April 2024; combines literature and participant workshops on Indigenous climate vulnerability, adaptation and risk.
methodology: Consultancy report combining literature and Mapuche workshops.
limitations: Proposed input, not official policy; Indigenous-specific indicators lack public disaggregated data.

title: Emergency: Wildfires in Chile. Humanitarian Flash Note No. 2
temporal_coverage: Humanitarian situation and response during central and southern Chile wildfires, February–7 March 2024.
methodology: UNICEF flash report using official event data and a 44-interview rapid assessment in Viña del Mar.
limitations: Emergency snapshot; report does not attribute fires to climate change.

title: Chile ya cuenta con su primer Plan de Adaptación al Cambio Climático para los Recursos Hídricos
organization: Dirección General de Aguas, Ministry of Public Works (Chile)
temporal_coverage: DGA account published 28 September 2026 on the formal water-sector adaptation plan and implementation tools.
methodology: Agency page summarizing formal plan status, measures, pilot indicators and local capacity-building.
limitations: Describes plan inputs and implementation activities, not evaluated hydrological or household outcomes.

title: Resolución Exenta N° 244: Procedimiento de consulta previa y convocatoria a instituciones representativas del pueblo Mapuche
organization: Ministry of Social Development and Family, Subsecretariat of Social Services; Diario Oficial de Chile
temporal_coverage: Resolution published 3 July 2025; recitals summarize the Peace and Understanding Commission mandate and land-fund information through 2024.
methodology: Official resolution and recitals presenting the government's territorial-conflict framing, commission mandate and administrative land-fund data.
limitations: Official administrative framing, not an independent violence dataset or evaluation of conflict-resolution outcomes.
